what: Same-driver same-config positive/negative dual control for the expat composition probe (CVE-2022-43680 lineage). This verifies the probe MECHANISM only: it is not a platform runtime-confirmed finding and not a model-campaign outcome.

environment.config_overlay: _overlay/expat_config.h (XML_DTD=1, XML_CONTEXT_BYTES=1024; sha256 84f39ebc112c20b457fc3244b5cb917b84a3b4e0610afbc229032d3b20862da6, identical on both sides)

vulnerable.crash_site: hashTableIterInit (expat/lib/xmlparse.c:7148) <- dtdReset (xmlparse.c:6738) <- XML_ParserReset (xmlparse.c:1218) <- probe.c reset step
vulnerable.ordinal_convention: ordinal N allows the first N allocations counted from the XML_ExternalEntityParserCreate call and fails the next one -- the same allow-N-then-fail semantics as the official duff allocator. Ordinal 3 therefore equals the official allocation_count=3: the failing allocation is the FOURTH from the create, the encoding-name copy in parserInit (the site the official comment names). Empirically ordinals 1 and 2 also failed the create but the parent reset survived; the UAF fired at ordinal 3 (see the committed log).

fixed.result: clean: sweep completed all 64 ordinals, zero crashes, normal exit

official_reference.test: test_alloc_reset_after_external_entity_parser_create_fail (expat/tests/runtests.c, expat-up-fixed): handler rejects non-NULL context, encoding name "UTF-8" (comment: needs something non-NULL), allocation_count=3, XML_ParserReset(g_parser, NULL) after the failed create
official_reference.location: expat/tests/runtests.c (expat-up-fixed), handler rejects non-NULL context, encoding name "UTF-8" (comment: needs something non-NULL), allocation_count=3, XML_ParserReset(g_parser, NULL) after the failed create
official_reference.shared_dtd_path: expat/lib/xmlparse.c: if (! context) newDtd = oldDtd; (under XML_DTD) -- a NULL context is the shared-DTD semantics, not a sign of calling outside the real path

honesty: The dual control ran once per side on 2026-10-14 in the chain-probe container; logs preserved. The unit test suite asserts the probe composition and this evidence record's structure -- it does NOT re-run the container build (no expat checkout or clang assumption in CI).
